objective: Turn live execution failures into general hypotheses while preserving an independent path to substantial scoped improvement, rather than repeated exposed wins treated as superiority.

live_diagnosis.failure: Both reject non-JSON prose-shaped stop responses with empty source handles; no extraction, correction or promotion.
live_diagnosis.index_observations: runtime_status reports unavailable; list_files and list_methods return pages; no complete source read.
live_diagnosis.interpretation: Not output-cap truncation. Public behavior supports a premature-finalization/source-acquisition hypothesis, not proof of a single causal mechanism. Both first requests declare the terminal function despite empty evidence. Full source eligibility remains available, including when runtime is missing. No labels or accuracy inspected.

prospective_hypothesis.candidate: Common acquisition-first terminal eligibility, strict plain-JSON versus function-call instructions, and explicit source fallback for missing runtime.
prospective_hypothesis.mechanism: During exploration, expose the terminal tool only when at least one eligible complete source observation exists in the exact rendered candidate request; retain an honest empty terminal at forced budget finalization. Do not expose a misleading empty selection as task completion. Preserve strict whole-envelope validation and exact request binding, all eligible reads, original budgets and equal baseline/treatment access.
prospective_hypothesis.required_tests: Both arms, pending versus confirmed complete reads, full versus deferred fresh requests, empty capacity notices, malformed/raw/tool finals, unsupported runtime fallback, forced empty finalization, invalid/recovery attempt accounting and all actual-source cases. No answer-specific source hints or case-specific policies.
prospective_hypothesis.admission: Candidate only. Separate version, construction boundary, qualification and prospective freeze required; r3/r4 remain immutable and finish full accounting. Do not launch a successor merely because one exposed case improved.

primary_research.title: Which Self-Improvements Should We Trust? Reliable Self-Improvement When Agents Reuse Their Benchmarks
primary_research.posture: New research preprint; methodology candidate, not ARE validation or an admitted rule
primary_research.finding: REUSE separates development from independently drawn evaluation, restricts proposer feedback to promotion decisions, and budgets errors across candidates, rounds and possible decision histories. Its theorem assumes independent evaluation draws and decision-only feedback; experiments use classification pipelines, not this localization workflow.
primary_research.application_inference: Potential future evolution-engine evaluator firewall: keep diagnostics on development data, expose only a bounded promotion decision from protected confirmation, retain detailed certificates outside proposer access. Current exposed transcripts and per-task scores violate that premise; no retrospective guarantee. Repository-correlated tasks also require an appropriate sampling unit. Validate assumptions, protocol, test power and isolation before implementation.

primary_research.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
primary_research.finding: Adaptive reuse of holdout feedback can overfit; formal validity needs a controlled information-release mechanism, not just repeated conventional tests.
primary_research.application_inference: A new confirmation set is not development feedback. If used to redesign a candidate after failure, mark it exposed rather than silently recycling it as fresh confirmation.

primary_research.title: Official Defects4J repository
primary_research.finding: Official documentation separates active and deprecated bugs and describes Java11 reproducibility. Current online metadata does not replace the locally pinned v3.0.1 evidence.
primary_research.application_inference: Use pinned active-ID/source metadata for supply and preserve missing-runtime outcomes. Same-project new bug IDs are task-disjoint, not repository-independent or proof against unknown model training exposure.

confirmation_frontier: Existing source supply census covers854 active bugs/17 projects, with Chart SVN excluded from the prior Git cohort. Prior source-order32 and later32 cohorts were scored/exposed; canonical16 are also development. These historical figures are not a current unexposed count. Refresh a union of all recognized prepared and dispatched G01/G02/G03 manifests before selecting any IDs, fail closed on incomplete exposure inventory, and keep gold outside selector and running arms. Freeze candidate, comparator, target population, equal opportunities, complete-denominator reliability, substantial effect threshold, clustered/stratified uncertainty and cost guards before outcomes. No positive results from repeated exposed rounds enlarge confirmation sample size.
no_effects: No provider dispatch, new dataset selection/acquisition, reference label reads, statistical gate adoption, source repair, release or publication in this research boundary.
claim_ceiling: Observed public execution diagnosis and candidate methodology only; no causal proof, live improvement or superiority
open_questions: Does acquisition-first terminal eligibility reduce premature stopping without increasing failure or cost in other cases?
Can protected confirmation feedback be isolated from the proposer in the current engine without misleading audit claims?
What refreshed exposure union and source-ready target population permit genuinely disjoint confirmation?
Which predeclared practical improvement and uncertainty/cost requirements are supportable with available independent sampling units?
